item.title: Celebrating Black History Month: Meet rancher Rizpah Bellard
item.description: She's a rancher, educator and trailblazer. Rizpah Bellard is finding success while feeding the hungry.

item.title: Part of Underground Railroad found in closet of New York City museum
item.description: The Underground Railroad was a secret pathway to freedom for enslaved people escaping north, through woods, tunnels, private homes, under floorboards, inside churches and even hidden beneath wagons.

item.title: Man who allegedly robbed postal worker at gunpoint in central Fresno arrested, jail records show
item.description: Fresno County jail records show 38-year-old Frankie Luna Ochoa, the man who allegedly robbed a postal worker at gunpoint in central Fresno, has been arrested.

item.title: Prominent school photography company Lifetouch under scrutiny amid Epstein files rumor: What to know
item.description: Lifetouch, one of the most prominent school photography companies in the country, is facing district investigations and canceled school photo days over Jeffrey Epstein files rumors. Here's what parents and students should know.

item.title: Woman found dead in Woodward Park, no foul play suspected, police say
item.description: A woman was found dead in Woodward Park on Saturday morning. Police say there are no signs of foul play.

item.title: Hanford bar employee hospitalized after shooting, police say
item.description: An employee at a Hanford bar has been hospitalized following a shooting early Saturday morning.

item.title: Some crop harvests in danger as Central Valley braces for storms
item.description: As the Central Valley braces for several days of heavy rain, some farmers say they're worried about the impact on certain crops.

item.title: States reliant on Colorado River fail to meet latest deadline to find water use consensus
item.description: The seven Western states that depend on the Colorado River missed a deadline for the second time Saturday to agree on a plan addressing record drought and water shortages.

item.title: Valley veteran looks forward to Valentine's Day dinner with wife after years of battling tremors
item.description: A Valley veteran regains control from severe tremors with a breakthrough device, restoring his music, service, and cherished moments with his wife.

item.title: European nations say Alexei Navalny was poisoned by the Kremlin with dart frog toxin
item.description: Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny was poisoned by the Kremlin with a rare and lethal toxin found in the skin of poison dart frogs, five European countries said.
